verdict: Separate, with a scoring model that works, or off. On W-2 forms integrated scoring separated right from wrong values better than the default separate pass with Amazon Nova Lite (AUROC 0.76 against 0.47) and used 36% fewer tokens per page, but it lowered extraction accuracy from 0.96 to 0.92. Turning confidence off changed no extracted value and cut tokens per page by 55% to 65%. On RealKIE invoices integrated ran as a separate pass, because in single-pass extraction the accelerator scores a class with list fields separately. For confidence you can act on, use a separate pass with Claude Haiku 5.5 or Claude Sonnet 5 (see CF-02).
